Temperature Range refers to the range of temperatures within which the adhesive can effectively bond and maintain its properties.
Used For refers to the specific purposes or applications for which the adhesive is intended, such as crafting, woodworking, household repairs, or industrial assembly.
Brand is the name of the company under which the product is marketed and sold.
Size refers to the dimensions or measurements of a product.
Applicator Type refers to the method or tool used for applying the adhesive.
Composition refers to the ingredients or components present in the adhesive.
Pack of refers to the total number of main products that are included by the brand in the package.
Viscosity refers to the adhesive's resistance to flow or deformation under applied force, indicating its thickness or fluidity.
Other Dimensions refer to any additional information on the dimensions of the product that would be useful to a customer.
Suitable For refers to the specific materials that the adhesive is best designed for.

Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Makro website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.
Dry Time refers to the duration required for the adhesive to fully cure and reach maximum bonding strength.
qualifierDescription: Dry Time refers to the duration required for the adhesive to completely dry and form a bond. The possible values are min, hr.

attributeDescription: Model Name is a unique name given to a product by the manufacturer to easily identify or differentiate between products.
Packaging Type specifies the packaging type of the product.
Weight refers to the weight of the product only, without packaging.
qualifierDescription: Weight refers to the unit in which weight is being measured. The possible values are kg, lbs, g, oz.

attributeDescription: Please write a few lines describing your product. Description is limited to 5000 characters (including spaces). It should not include any hyperlinks, additional offers, or promotion text.
exampleValue: Multipurpose woodworking adhesive SH combines with wood fibres to give a strong and lasting bond (2) It is thicker and applied with hard card fevicol SH is also known as carpenters glue.

attributeDescription: Specific Gravity refers to the ratio of the density of the adhesive to the density of water.
Shelf Life refers to the length of time during which a product remains safe to use while maintaining its desired quality.
qualifierDescription: Shelf Life refers to the unit used to measure the maximum shelf life of the product. The possible values are Day, Month.

attributeDescription: Product VAT Applicable indicates whether VAT is levied on the product at the standard rate of 15% (TRUE), or if the product specifically qualifies for zero rating (0%) in South Africa (FALSE).
Bond Time refers to the time required for the adhesive to achieve initial bonding strength after application.
qualifierDescription: Bond Time refers to the duration required for the adhesive to fully set and create a secure bond. The possible values are min, hr.

attributeDescription: Adhesive Strength refers to the adhesive's ability to withstand applied loads or stresses without failing at the bond interface.
Wet Colour refers to the colour appearance of the adhesive when it is in its liquid or uncured state.
Other Features refer to any additional information on the features of the product that would be useful to a customer.
exampleValue: Can be used for crack seepage||Window sill seepage

attributeDescription: Usage Instructions refer to the guidance on how to properly use the product for optimal results.
exampleValue: Apply the adhesive evenly to one or both surfaces||Allow the adhesive to set or cure according to the recommended time and conditions

attributeDescription: EAN refers to the 13 digits unique bar code given to each product which is universally recognisable.
Depth refers to the distance from the front to the back of the product.
qualifierDescription: Depth refers to the unit used to measure depth. The possible values are cm, mm, inch.

attributeDescription: Permanent refers to whether the adhesive forms a permanent bond upon drying or curing.
Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of the product.
qualifierDescription: Width refers to the unit used to measure external width of the product. The possible values are cm, mm, inch.

attributeDescription: Dry Colour refers to the colour appearance of the adhesive after it has fully cured and dried.
Adhesive Type refers to the form or consistency of the adhesive.

Sales Package gives the information of all the contents that are sold in the package. Please specify the package information along with the number of each content mentioned before the name. Data should be double pipe (||) separated.
Dyed refers to whether the adhesive is tinted or coloured for aesthetic purposes.
Quantity refers to the total volume or amount of the product.
qualifierDescription: Quantity refers to the number of items included. The possible values are ml, L, g, kg.

attributeDescription: Certifications refer to a document prepared by a notified body that describes and validates the authenticity and key characteristics of a product.
Resistance Type refers to the specific type of resistance offered by the adhesive, ensuring reliable bonding.
